{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|Presidente Shu Mai|<ref name="Approaching">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''Keitum system''' was a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keitum/Legends|Keitum]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], it was affiliated via the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]] to seven other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. That alliance was part of a larger network of forty systems linked by various alliances and treaties to each other, centered on the inconspicuous planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when members of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty were considering seceding from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of the Independent Systems]] sought to facilitate the secession of the entire network of systems affiliated with Ansion. The Separatist plans were foiled by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]], which resulted in the planet and its partner systems remaining loyal to the Republic. Following the subsequent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Keitum system successively fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Description==
The Keitum [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGTW" /> It was situated at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rago Run]],<ref name="Rago Run" /> which linked it to the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]] in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keitum/Legends|Keitum]].<ref name="CSWE Keitumite" /><ref name="Fry" />

==History==
===A web of alliances===
{{Quote|The Malarian Alliance. On the face of it, one of hundreds of such casual alliances. Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty. Never invoked, but still in force. Now, observe this.|Presidente Shu Mai, before displaying the network of star systems politically connected to Ansion|<ref name="Approaching" />}}
[[File:Ansion-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Confederacy of Independent Systems intended to use the connections of the planet Ansion (pictured) to the Keitum system and others for political gain.]]
The Keitum system was situated in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Scout/Legends|explored]] at some point between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', during which the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]] is in effect, to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> it was both a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a signatory of<ref name="TEA" /> the never-invoked<ref name="Approaching" /> [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]], the latter of which placed it in a web of mutual affiliations with seven other systems: the [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin]] and [[Mondress system/Legends|Mondress systems]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]; the [[Eeropha system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]; and the Ansion, [[Glom Tho system/Legends|Glom Tho]], [[Lonnaw system/Legends|Lonnaw]], and [[Malari system/Legends|Malari systems]] in the Mid Rim. In addition, Keitum, its partner systems, and the [[Malarian Alliance]]&mdash;also affiliated with the planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]&mdash;all had treaties of their own with other worlds, which led to the seemingly insignificant Ansion lying at the center of a network of approximately forty [[Politics/Legends|politically]] connected [[Star/Legends|star]] systems. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]],<ref name="TEA" /> signatory systems of both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty were individually considering leaving the Republic.<ref name="Approaching" />

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] intended to facilitate the secession of Ansion from the Republic, which was predicted by the Separatists to cause a cascade of secession by all the systems linked to the planet via its treaties as well.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|shumai|Mai, Shu}}</ref> [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] explained the Separatist plan to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] industrialist [[Tam Uliss]] and his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek (Tam Uliss)|companion]] during a meeting with Ansion's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mousul]] in a private chamber on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Approaching" /> a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet that served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Republic,<ref name="TEA" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY" /> Mai also singled out the member systems of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty for the group in a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projection of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Approaching" /> However, a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]] undertaken at the [[Time/Legends|time]] by [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on behalf of the Republic ultimately resulted in that world<ref name="TEA" /> and its partners remaining loyal to the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government,<ref name="Approaching" /> foiling the Separatist plans.<ref name="TEA" />

===Clone Wars and beyond===
During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in 22 BBY, the Republic's [[Seventh Army|Seventh Sector Army]] was tasked with defending the Keitum system's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy.<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the Commerce Guild during that conflict, the Keitum system was featured on a galactic [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

At some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the newly appointed Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Mid Rim's [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]] declared all existing treaties and alliances involving Ansion to be null and void,<ref name="TEA" /> and by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Keitum system was situated within the territory controlled by the Empire. Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the Keitum system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="EGTW" /> but control over the system had been passed to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Keitum was the origin point of the social group known as the [[Keitumite]]s,<ref name="CSWE Keitumite" /> and the Keitum system's population around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one hundred and five hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', a [[2002]] novel by [[Alan Dean Foster]], featured a holographic representation of the several unnamed star systems connected to the planet Ansion via the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty.<ref name="Approaching" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], subsequently identified one of those systems as the Keitum system and placed it in grid square J-6.<ref name="TEA" />
